stage: Stage A (Order Checkout / Creation Point T0)
intended_operational_interpretation: Targeted risk-alerting layer designed to surface high-confidence SLA breach risks for supervisor/dispatcher operational escalation under capacity-constrained human review budgets.

policy_selection_rationale.assumption: Human operational review capacity is finite; not all predicted breaches can receive manual handling. Alert volume must be constrained to ~25-30% of total volume with high precision.
policy_selection_rationale.threshold_selection: 0.9300 is selected because it filters the high-confidence upper quartile tail. It is NOT claimed to be mathematically optimal.
policy_selection_rationale.model_selection: LightGBMClassifier is selected because it captures +15.8% more breaches (+485 orders on validation) than Logistic Regression at equal precision (~94%) within the operational alert budget, while operating on a clean 7-feature pipeline without one-hot expansion.

synthetic_data_disclaimer: All models, thresholds, and performance metrics represent prototype evaluations on synthetic quick-commerce operational data. This model is not production-ready.
